summary: Stantec announced a TSX-approved amendment to its Normal Course Issuer Bid, increasing the maximum repurchase for cancellation from 2,281,339 (2%) to 5,703,349 common shares (5% of shares as of March 2, 2026). As of August 17, 2026, Stantec had repurchased 1,667,292 shares at a weighted average of $103.43. The amended NCIB runs from August 20, 2026 to no later than March 11, 2027, with the existing automatic share purchase plan (ASPP) remaining in effect. This capital return program aims to enhance shareholder returns while maintaining balance sheet strength. Watch repurchase pace and share-price support under the expanded cap.
